headline: Singapore Fuel Oil Stocks Rise 7% in November on Higher Net Imports
summary: Data from Enterprise Singapore shows residual fuel oil stocks increased 1.26 million barrels to 19.82 million barrels in November, representing a 7% rise over October levels. Middle distillate stocks fell to 8.73 million barrels.
why: Singapore is the global trading and bunkering hub for marine fuel oils; inventory shifts reflect regional shipping and refining supply dynamics.
